decisions.reason: Identifies `disabled: (props.input?.phase ?? 'plain') !== 'plain' || busy` in AttachmentChips as the throwing expression, grounds it in the shipped fixture code, explains busy is a local of sibling AttachButton and unbound in AttachmentChips (ReferenceError at render), notes empty occurrences return null before the map, and explains the || short-circuit: left guard true in non-plain phase never reads busy, so plain phase with an occurrence finally evaluates it.

Explains the render exception is caught by the slot-level error boundary which unmounts the whole dock entry, so the entire chip dock disappears rather than just the remove button; the attach button survives in its separate input.left slot, and the error is visible only in the browser console with no user-facing banner.

Uses the shipped v0.2.10 source to show busy already occurs in the baseline, so the hover diff is not the root cause; proposes a data-present plain-phase minimal mount of the v0.2.10 artifact and a rollback/re-add bisect as isolation. Also credits grounded diff inconsistencies: feature.diff contradicts the baseline about the || busy line and hoists imageItem above the callback where record/status are declared (flagging window.status hazards). It frames v0.2.11 as first exercising, not causing, the latent bug without overclaiming historical usage.

Primary fix removes the dangling busy reference (or threads explicitly owned state via props) while preserving the phase guard; adds record?.items ?? [] defensive reads explaining the async-partial-data hazard, optional-calls event.target.closest?.() with rationale, and moves the hoisted imageItem lookup inside the map callback after record/status are defined.

Proposes a render smoke mounting the dock with one occurrence in plain phase, asserting the chip/remove control renders via DOM/label queries and zero error-boundary captures; explains the empty-state test returns null before the throwing line and that node --check/parse-only passes cannot resolve free identifiers. Recommends a data-present slot render smoke on the shipped artifact as the pre-ship gate; no actual test execution required.
